name: BoolODE Boolean model
description: BoolODE Boolean-rule model table consumed as the model_definition file. Each row defines one gene and the Boolean rule controlling that gene.
example:
Gene	Rule
a	not(c)
c	not(b)
b	not(a)
validation_notes: The Gene column contains BoolODE gene identifiers used in expression and truth outputs.
The Rule column uses BoolODE Boolean syntax with gene identifiers, parentheses and the logical operators and, or and not.
Identifiers referenced in rules should either have their own Gene row or be supplied as fixed inputs through a boolode_parameter_inputs file.
BoolODE may add self-activation rules for referenced nodes without explicit rules when they are not declared as parameter inputs.
